description: Look up what this project already says — one key across locales, or keys matching a search, decoded exactly as the stringlane engine reads them. Use this instead of opening a locale file: four of the five supported formats escape, prefix or nest their values, so the bytes on disk are not the string. Reads only; writes nothing. Takes no file paths — the project is fixed when the server starts.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous result. Opaque — pass it back, do not parse it.

key.description: An exact key, as prepare_translation_plan spells it. Omit to list.

limit.description: Maximum translations (not keys) per page. Default 200, maximum 2000.

locales.description: Locale codes to read. Omit for every locale, base included.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against KEYS, not values. Cannot be used with key.

name: read_translations
title: Read existing translations
